items.title: Sublingual semaglutide offered to UK practices despite Novo Nordisk concerns
items.summary: Sublingual semaglutide, which does not hold marketing authorisation, is touted to minimise gastric issues.

items.title: Boosting CGT access: a global consideration with wide-spanning benefits
items.summary: Wider patient access to CGTs hinges on further infrastructure developments and the movement of therapies into the community setting.

items.title: J&J ventures further into in vivo CAR-T space with Sail partnership, potential buyout
items.summary: J&J strikes its deal with Sail as the in vivo CAR-T space becomes increasingly crowded, with several big pharma players betting on the class.

items.title: miRecule and Rio Biofarma to develop RNA therapeutic delivery technologies
items.summary: miRecule has signed a research collaboration with Rio Biofarma Brasil (RBBL) to co-develop peptide-mediated delivery technologies aimed at improving targeted RNA therapeutics delivery to tissues beyond the liver and muscles in a range of disease areas.

items.title: European drug manufacturers under threat from proposed US supply chain bill
items.summary: US efforts to scrutinise overseas drug manufacturing could expose Europe’s role in supplying FDA-approved innovator and biosimilar drugs.
